target: Brutal Mario Demo11 Node Music Scope
scope: Scope the accepted room106 BGM dispatch to the exact map-node X word. The accepted demo11-room106-music patch compared only the 8-bit low byte at $1F17, so the Star World middle-left node (X=$0158) also selected slot 0x33 and masked the forest donor track 0x5D. The dispatch relocates to a private shim that compares the full word $1F17 against #$0058, keeps the room106 node on slot 0x33 and passes every other node its original $0DDA request. The room120 node keeps 0x49.

code_patches.role: relocate the node-bound BGM dispatch to the exact-word shim
